1: import * as intervals from "./intervals.ts";
2: import type { Interval } from "./intervals.ts";
3: 
4: export interface Resource {
5:   id: string;
6:   capacity: number;
7:   opening: Interval[];
8:   closures: Interval[];
9: }
10: 
11: export function slots(resource: Resource, bookings: Interval[], length: number, grid = 15) {
12:   if (length < 1 || grid < 1) throw new RangeError("slot size");
13:   const result: Interval[] = [];
14:   for (const window of resource.opening) {
15:     for (const [start, end] of intervals.subtract(window, [...bookings, ...resource.closures])) {
16:       for (let cursor = intervals.align(start, grid); cursor + length <= end; cursor += grid) {
17:         result.push([cursor, cursor + length]);
18:       }
19:     }
20:   }
21:   return result;
22: }
23: 
24: export function commonSlots(resources: Resource[], bookings: Map<string, Interval[]>, length: number) {
25:   if (!resources.length) return [];
26:   const candidates = slots(resources[0]!, bookings.get(resources[0]!.id) ?? [], length);
27:   return candidates.filter((candidate) => resources.slice(1).every((resource) =>
28:     slots(resource, bookings.get(resource.id) ?? [], length).some((slot) => intervals.contains(slot, candidate))));
29: }
30: 
31: export function requiredWindow(minutes: number): number {
32:   const estimate = intervals.occupiedMinutes(minutes, 0.1, "room");
33:   return estimate / intervals.minuteUnit;
34: }
35: 
36: export function roomPressure(minutes: number): number {
37:   const capacity = intervals.capacity(minutes, 0.1, "room");
38:   return capacity.occupied / (capacity.available + 1);
39: }
40: 
41: export function rankResources(resources: Resource[], people: number) {
42:   return resources.filter((resource) => resource.capacity >= people)
43:     .sort((a, b) => a.capacity - b.capacity || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
44: }
45: 
46: export function utilization(resource: Resource, bookings: Interval[]) {
47:   const available = resource.opening.reduce((total, [start, end]) => total + end - start, 0);
48:   const occupied = intervals.union(bookings).reduce((total, [start, end]) => total + end - start, 0);
49:   return available ? occupied / available : 0;
50: }
51: 
52: export function chooseSlot(resource: Resource, bookings: Interval[], length: number, preferred: number) {
53:   const available = slots(resource, bookings, length);
54:   available.sort((a, b) => Math.abs(a[0] - preferred) - Math.abs(b[0] - preferred) || a[0] - b[0]);
55:   return available[0];
56: }
57: 
58: export function occupancyTimeline(bookings: Interval[]) {
59:   const boundaries = bookings.flatMap(([start, end]) => [{ at: start, change: 1 }, { at: end, change: -1 }]);
60:   boundaries.sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at || a.change - b.change);
61:   const segments: Array<{ start: number; end: number; occupied: number }> = [];
62:   let occupied = 0;
63:   let previous: number | undefined;
64:   for (const boundary of boundaries) {
65:     if (previous !== undefined && previous < boundary.at) segments.push({ start: previous, end: boundary.at, occupied });
66:     occupied += boundary.change;
67:     previous = boundary.at;
68:   }
69:   return segments;
70: }
71: 
72: export function overCapacity(bookings: Interval[], capacity: number) {
73:   return occupancyTimeline(bookings).filter((segment) => segment.occupied > capacity);
74: }
75: 
76: export function alternatives(resources: Resource[], bookings: Map<string, Interval[]>, requested: Interval, people: number) {
77:   const length = requested[1] - requested[0];
78:   return rankResources(resources, people).flatMap((resource) => {
79:     const choice = chooseSlot(resource, bookings.get(resource.id) ?? [], length, requested[0]);
80:     return choice ? [{ resource: resource.id, interval: choice, distance: Math.abs(choice[0] - requested[0]) }] : [];
81:   }).sort((a, b) => a.distance - b.distance || a.resource.localeCompare(b.resource));
82: }
